key_insight: For deep linear neural networks with regularized squared loss, SGD iterates remain almost surely bounded and converge to the set of critical points under mild conditions.
engineering_relevance: The results strengthen theoretical foundations for stochastic training with deterministic or adaptive step sizes, though they do not directly establish guarantees for nonlinear networks.
method: Extend gradient-descent convergence analysis to SGD in deep linear networks.
Establish almost sure boundedness of the iterates.
Use asymptotic pseudotrajectories to prove convergence without relying on Lipschitz properties or whitened data.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical convergence guarantees but describes no datasets, experiments, or empirical benchmarks.
watch_item: Convergence to the critical-point set does not by itself guarantee convergence to a global minimizer or provide a training-time rate.
paper_title: Convergence of stochastic gradient descent for learning linear neural networks
